bundle.shortDescription: Free screen recorder that saves to your disk
bundle.longDescription: Butterfly Record records your screen or a window with your microphone and saves each recording as a regular video file in your Videos folder. Recordings never leave your computer unless you choose to. It transcribes any video on your PC, and with your own Sarvam API key it can translate the subtitles, dub the video into another Indian language and write a title and summary.
